docs/rust-guide.md.text: # Rust authoring guide One `Project` describes a publication. Create it with a stable namespace, add notes under stable keys, and build an APKG. Common types are imported directly from `ankiforge`; advanced options live in the public domain modules. ## Projects and diagnostics ```rust use ankiforge::{BuildOptions, Content, Note, Project}; fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> { let mut project = Project::new("jp-core")? .default_deck("Japanese::Core"); project.add("taberu", Note::basic("食べる", Content::html("to eat")))?; let output = project.build(BuildOptions::to("jp-core.apkg"))?; println!("{} notes", output.report().counts().notes); println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output.snapshot())?); Ok(()) } ``` A successful build returns `BuildOutput` with a guaranteed artifact. `BuildReport` contains observations: counts, diagnostics, elapsed time and any completed comparison. It contains no outcome or artifact ownership. Warnings do not turn a successful output into a failure. Schema errors are checked when a model is completed. `Project::add` checks the note's key, field references, required fields, deck, tags, and dependency conflicts atomically. Failure leaves the project unchanged. The build performs remaining card, package and update checks. There is no separate mutable registry or required validation checkpoint. Errors expose inherent `kind()` and `code()` methods and implement `std::error::Error`. Use machine codes rather than parsing the displayed message. `BuildError::snapshot()` includes the real failure, observations, source-chain text and publication facts. Standard error wrappers can preserve the original error as their source. ## Models and assets A completed `NoteType` is immutable and shareable. Call `model.note()`, assign fields by stable key, and add the result to a project. The note holds its model; adding it collects the model and media automatically. Use [custom note types](custom-notetypes.md) for declarations and template rules. `Media::file` and `Media::bytes` acquire owned snapshots. Source files need not remain available after import succeeds. `image.image()` and `audio.sound()` produce structured content; `Content::sequence` combines them with text or HTML. Raw HTML/CSS/script assets must be explicitly included using `builder.asset` or `project.add_asset`. See [media](media.md) and [template bundles](template-bundles.md). ## Output ownership Choose `BuildOptions::to(path)` for a persistent output or `BuildOptions::temporary()` for an owned temporary file. Retain the output or a clone of `output.artifact()` while accessing a temporary path. Its last owner removes the file. `persist_to(path)` returns a persistent artifact; on failure the original owner remains usable. JSON snapshots contain paths but do not own files. ## Stable note identity Use a durable source-record key with `project.add(key, note)`. The project namespace, model key, field keys and template keys are independent of display names. Content changes do not create a new logical note. Duplicate keys fail instead of overwriting. Save and reuse your chosen keys when source records are reordered or edited. ## Updating distributed decks Use the previous original distribution APKG with `update_from`. Its complete embedded evidence preserves identity and revision mappings. Independent `project.compare(CompareOptions::against(path))` analyzes the candidate and reports whether policy would permit publication. See the [two-version workflow](updates.md) for high-risk changes, client import limitations and explicit allowances. From a checkout, these examples execute the same public API: ```sh cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example target_api_basic cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example target_api_custom_notetype cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example target_api_media cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example docs_workflow -- target/docs-examples ``` ### Addition errors and media categories `Project` uses a stable namespace and optional default deck; it has no display title. `NoteType`, `Field` and `Template` still support display names. `Project::add` is atomic. Inspect `AddError::context()` for note/model keys and `note::AddTarget` for the original location; `detail()` returns `note::AddDetail` for conflicts or incompatible media usage. Match these non-exhaustive enums with `..` on data variants and a fallback arm. A field's `content_path` is `None` for the field, `Some([])` for its root, or sequence indices for a nested node. Separator byte ranges point into the original UTF-8 Text/Html leaf. `Media::image()` and `sound()` remain infallible. Addition requires `image/*` for images and `audio/*` or `video/*` for sound references. Other categories produce `NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID`. This checks retained MIME, not decoding or playback. Raw HTML and explicit assets retain their existing behavior. Export renaming does not change MIME: a PNG renamed `wrong.mp3` passes image addition but can still fail build's independent sniffing/extension check with `MEDIA.DECLARED_MIME_MISMATCH`. Tool recipes now require `ankiforge-project-v2` without top-level `name`; v1 is rejected. Contract bundle is 2.1.0; package identity stays `ankiforge-identity-v1`.

docs/zh-cn/rust-guide.md.text: # Rust 编写指南 一个 `Project` 描述一次发布。用稳定命名空间创建项目，以稳定键添加笔记，再构建 APKG。常用类型直接从 `ankiforge` 导入；高级选项位于公开的领域模块。 ## 项目与诊断 ```rust use ankiforge::{BuildOptions, Content, Note, Project}; fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> { let mut project = Project::new("jp-core")? .default_deck("Japanese::Core"); project.add("taberu", Note::basic("食べる", Content::html("to eat")))?; let output = project.build(BuildOptions::to("jp-core.apkg"))?; println!("{} notes", output.report().counts().notes); println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output.snapshot())?); Ok(()) } ``` 成功构建返回包含确定产物的 `BuildOutput`。`BuildReport` 仅含观察结果：数量、诊断、耗时和已完成的比较。它不包含操作结果，也不拥有产物。警告不会把成功输出变为失败。 模型完成时检查 schema 错误。`Project::add` 原子地检查笔记键、字段引用、必填字段、牌组、标签与依赖冲突。失败不改变项目。构建执行剩余的卡片、包和更新检查。没有独立可变注册表，也不要求额外的校验检查点。 错误提供固有的 `kind()` 和 `code()` 方法，并实现 `std::error::Error`。请使用机器码，不要解析显示消息。`BuildError::snapshot()` 包含真实失败、观察结果、来源链文本和发布事实。标准错误包装器可以将原始错误保留为来源。 ## 模型与资源 完成的 `NoteType` 不可变且可共享。调用 `model.note()`，按稳定键赋值，再把结果加入项目。笔记持有模型；添加时自动收集模型和媒体。声明与模板规则见[自定义笔记类型](../custom-notetypes.md)。 `Media::file` 与 `Media::bytes` 获取拥有所有权的快照。导入成功后不再需要保留源文件。`image.image()` 和 `audio.sound()` 生成结构化内容；`Content::sequence` 将它们与文本或 HTML 组合。原始 HTML、CSS 或脚本资源必须通过 `builder.asset` 或 `project.add_asset` 显式包含。参见[媒体](../media.md)和[模板包](../template-bundles.md)。 ## 输出所有权 持久输出选择 `BuildOptions::to(path)`，拥有所有权的临时文件选择 `BuildOptions::temporary()`。访问临时路径时保留输出对象或 `output.artifact()` 的克隆。最后一个所有者会删除文件。`persist_to(path)` 返回持久产物；失败时原所有者仍可用。JSON 快照包含路径，但不拥有文件。 ## 稳定笔记身份 为 `project.add(key, note)` 使用持久的源记录键。项目命名空间、模型键、字段键和模板键独立于显示名称。内容变化不会创建新逻辑笔记。重复键会失败，而非覆盖。源记录重新排序或编辑时，保存并复用所选键。 ## 更新已分发的牌组 向 `update_from` 提供上一次原始分发 APKG。完整的内嵌证据保留身份和修订映射。独立的 `project.compare(CompareOptions::against(path))` 分析候选包，并报告策略是否允许发布。高风险变更、客户端导入限制和显式放行见[双版本流程](../updates.md)。 从源码目录运行以下示例，它们执行相同的公开 API： ```sh cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example target_api_basic cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example target_api_custom_notetype cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example target_api_media cargo run --locked -p ankiforge --example docs_workflow -- target/docs-examples ``` ### 添加错误与媒体类别 `Project` 使用稳定命名空间和可选默认牌组，没有显示标题。`NoteType`、`Field` 与 `Template` 仍支持显示名称。`Project::add` 是原子操作。通过 `AddError::context()` 查看笔记或模型键，通过 `note::AddTarget` 查看原始位置；`detail()` 返回 `note::AddDetail`，说明冲突或不兼容媒体用法。匹配这些非穷尽枚举时，对数据变体使用 `..`，并提供兜底分支。字段的 `content_path` 为 `None` 时指字段本身，`Some([])` 指其根，序列下标则指嵌套节点。分隔符字节范围指向原始 UTF-8 Text/Html 叶节点。 `Media::image()` 和 `sound()` 保持不会失败。添加时，图片要求 `image/*`，声音引用要求 `audio/*` 或 `video/*`。其他类别产生 `NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID`。这检查保留的 MIME，并非解码或播放。原始 HTML 和显式资源保持原有行为。导出重命名不会改变 MIME：PNG 改名为 `wrong.mp3` 后可以通过图片添加，但构建的独立探测或扩展名检查仍可能返回 `MEDIA.DECLARED_MIME_MISMATCH`。 工具输入现在要求 `ankiforge-project-v2`，且没有顶层 `name`；v1 被拒绝。契约包为 2.1.0；包身份格式仍为 `ankiforge-identity-v1`。
